learner: Unchanged LightGBM 4.6.0 and the original 50,000-row sample, settings and seed

cold_start.fallback: audited entity-table features, refitted inside the measured session
cold_start.other_task_memory: keys and meanings only; no requirement to validate a sibling task's SQL
cold_start.selection: validation score only; both attempts' cost included

reuse.sql_fusion: Only aggregates with identical complete input relation, seed mapping, filters, joins, deduplication and time bounds share a scan

acceptance.quality_comparison: Each mean test metric must beat or tie the strongest reported baseline, using unrounded values
acceptance.cost_comparison: All six reuse-cost columns must be no worse than the original mavra-push run under the unchanged paper metric definitions; token ratio uses the same no-memory denominator
acceptance.publication_rule: Do not replace paper numbers until complete paired evaluation and the cost/quality gates pass; retain every completed or failed candidate result

limits: Design follows inspection of existing test results and is disclosed as post-hoc development
A single run and five correlated cutoffs cannot establish a universal quality guarantee
Observed time is measured on the shared server and includes all new memory selection, fitting and SQL work; leak-audit time follows the existing separate accounting
